title: Drivers of Cost Increases in Healthcare
what_it_is: Drivers of Cost Increases in Healthcare

sections.label: Hospital stay length by age
sections.summary: In 2019, average public hospital stay for those aged 65 and above was 6.9 days, versus about 3.9 days for those below 65.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For example, in 2019, the average stay in our public hospitals for those aged 65 and above was 6.9 days, compared to those who are below 65 where the average stay was about 3.9 days.

sections.label: Long-term care expenditure increase
sections.summary: MOH's long-term care expenditure rose from $296 million to $723 million between 2013 and 2018, a 20% increase per annum.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For example, MOH's expenditure on the long-term care sector increased from $296 million to $723 million between 2013 and 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Or if you work it out, it is a 20% increase per annum.

sections.label: Knee replacement prevalence and manpower costs
sections.summary: Total Knee Replacement prevalence among those aged 65 and above rose from 187 to 499 per 100,000 between 1999 and 2019, and manpower costs are about 60% of healthcare costs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For example, Total Knee Replacement surgeries have become more prevalent among those aged 65 and above over the last 20 years, rising from 187 patients for every 100,000 people aged 65 and above in 1999, to 499 patients in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: That is a 2.7-times increase in the prevalence rate over that time period.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For example, manpower costs account for about 60% of healthcare costs.

sections.label: CHAS Green and hospice coverage
sections.summary: CHAS Green card was introduced last year and MediShield Life coverage to inpatient hospice care in April this year, part of the overall strategy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: CHAS Green card was introduced last year and MediShield Life coverage to inpatient hospice care was also introduced in April this year, being part of this overall strategy.

sections.label: Productivity, technology and fee benchmarks
sections.summary: Emphasis continues on raising productivity and tapping technology, with fee benchmarks for common surgical procedures introduced in November 2018 to guide charging and inform patients.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We continue to put emphasis on raising productivity and tapping on technology where available.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We introduced fee benchmarks for common surgical procedures in November 2018 to guide private sector doctors and healthcare providers in charging appropriately and to enable patients to make better informed healthcare decisions.
